Signed out, the plan link opens a stepped sign-in: email + Enter, then password + Enter. No code was asked. It then lands on Deezer's payment page with Adyen secured fields (checkoutshopper-live.adyen.com, iframes titled 'Iframe for card number' / 'Iframe for expiry date' / 'Iframe for security code').

The Adyen iframes are in the DOM but hidden until the card payment option is clicked (the one visible Credit/Debit/Card text). Holder name (input[name=holderName]) is on the page; fill it in an earlier call than the card number. Expiry is one MM/YY input.

The offer is a free trial: the page says nothing is charged before the trial ends, and the submit button's label contains 'trial'. Eligible only for accounts with no previous Deezer subscription or trial.

Observed 2026-10-07 through the proxy (US tunnel, Dallas) with the public test card under a verification-only key: holder name, expiry, number and security code filled with no error. Stopped before the submit button.
